market_question: Will Dan Cox win the 2026 Maryland Governor Republican primary election?
reasoning: Dan Cox overperformed in 2022 due to Trump endorsement but lost the general election by ~28 points. Former Governor Larry Hogan (moderate, high approval) has not ruled out running again in 2026 and would be a prohibitive favorite if he enters; even without Hogan, Cox would face strong centrist and establishment candidates. A fair probability that Cox wins the primary is roughly 23%, far below the 57.5% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Hogan told Baltimore Sun (Feb 2025) he is 'not closing any doors' on a 2026 run
If Hogan runs he would unify the moderate/establishment lane and make Cox a heavy underdog
Cox's 2022 general-election blowout (36% vs Moore's 64%) weakens his electability argument among primary voters
sources_consulted: Baltimore Sun: 'Larry Hogan won’t rule out running for governor again in 2026'
Generic GOP primary dynamics in deep-blue states with strong moderate factions
